title: Add 'Validate PAN' and 'Validate Aadhar' action buttons on the Candidate Onboard
description:
[The user currently has the "Candidate Onboarding Record" screen open (object emponb_candidate_record, type T). Resolve "this", "this form/page/screen", or "here" to this object unless they name a different one.]

OnClick 'Validate PAN', 'Validate Aadhar', call IOFLOW event 'EmpOnboardingValidate' and pass 'ValidatePAN'/ 'ValidateAadhar', candidate_id, pan_no / aadhar_no for the candidate_id.
